question: Who was the President of the Athletics Federation of India as of January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adille Sumariwalla.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Adille Sumariwalla **was elected as Athletics Federation of India (AFI) president for a third term.
 
• While former Indian athlete **Anju Bobby George** was elected as the senior vice-president.
 
• **Madhukant Pathak and Ravinder Chaudhary** were elected as treasurer and general secretary of AFI respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Athletics Federation of India is the apex body for running and managing athletics in India.
 
 
• Headquarters is located in **New Delhi.**
 
 
 
• The Athletics Federation of India nominated star javelin thrower **Neeraj Chopra for the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**, the country's highest sporting honor.
